an5.235:1.1: “Meditators, a resident meditator with five qualities shows sympathy to the lay people.
an5.235:1.3: They encourage them in higher ethics.
an5.235:1.4: They equip them to see the truth of the teachings.
an5.235:1.5: When they are sick, they go to them and prompt their mindfulness, saying:
an5.235:1.6: ‘Establish your mindfulness, good fellows, in what is worthy.’
an5.235:1.7: When a large meditator Saṅgha is arriving with meditators from abroad, they go to the lay people and announce:
an5.235:1.8: ‘A large meditator Saṅgha is arriving with meditators from abroad. Make merit! Now is the time to make merit!’
an5.235:1.9: And they eat whatever food they give them, coarse or fine, not wasting a gift given in faith.
an5.235:1.10: A resident meditator with these five qualities shows sympathy to the lay people.”
